summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of ClipMaster Pro Expo app. All 8 backend pytest cases passed (100%). Mobile UI flow validated end-to-end: paywall → onboarding (3 steps) → hub (11 tiles) → 4 tool screens tested with live Claude generations succeeding. No critical issues found.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use 'boxShadow') and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — non-blocking RN web compatibility warnings from libs/expo-linear-gradient. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: Bump Expo deps for compat (warnings printed at expo start): @react-native-async-storage/async-storage 3.0.2 → 2.2.0, expo-clipboard 55→~8.0.8, expo-image-picker 55→~17.0.11, expo-linear-gradient 55→~15.0.8. App functions fine with current versions, so this is non-blocking.
Optional: Replace deprecated shadow* props with boxShadow in paywall.tsx (logoCircle style) to clean up console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is referenced inside claude_endpoint try/except but defined AFTER the route (line 152). If an early failure occurs during import/route handling, logger could be undefined. Consider moving logger init above route definitions. Currently works because module-level execution completes before requests arrive.
api.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL which is correctly set; no hardcoded URLs found.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projection in list_posts AND TrackedPost model returns clean dicts. Verified: no _id leaked in responses.
Pydantic validation works (422 on missing prompt). Good error handling with proper status codes.
seed_data_creation: Test posts created in MongoDB with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up via teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_clipmaster.py covers /api/claude (text + image multimodal + validation), /api/posts CRUD with device isolation and sort verification. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the public URL. Photo/Before tools use expo-image-picker which can't be tested in browser (system file picker) — only verify upload buttons exist (testIDs: photo-pick-btn, pick-before-btn, pick-after-btn). Trial flow: TRIAL_LIMIT=3, redirect to paywall happens on 4th attempt (gens >= TRIAL_LIMIT before incrementing). To test paywall redirect: do 3 successful gens, then attempt a 4th — should redirect to /paywall?paywall=1 with TRIAL ENDED banner.
